sources.version: Frozen Version 12 internal manuscript; inherited results retain their source and review qualifications, not an independently published external theorem.
sources.locator: Retained generator, one-place, height, scalar coefficient, real-progression and preparation-zero lemmas; exact applications in the Version 13 inventory.

source_hypotheses.required: All inherited arithmetic hypotheses and every newly used lemma must apply to the constructed points and local conditions.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The same K, curve, generator, odd root labels, p>76176 places, height constant and pole inputs; revised H may be outside 2E(K).
source_hypotheses.justification: The addition replaces every affected H-index identity, proves exceptional-H exclusion before ratios and checks the scalar and comparison applications separately. Published inputs retain the existing version/convention qualifications.

constructed_objects.required: An integer polynomial with exactly the stated rational projection; fixed coefficients distinct from variables.
constructed_objects.constructed: 394-coordinate quadratic system, primitive sum of squares, and 411-coordinate ordinary coefficient companion.
constructed_objects.justification: The full composition review distinguishes source enlargements from exact witness maps. The numerical review checks reindexing, all coefficients and both companion transformations.

index_domain_coverage.required: Soundness for every allowed rational solution and simultaneous witnesses for every integer input, including identities and half-indices.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Ui and Vi may equal O; H=mR0+T with h=m/2 at odd primes; scalar R retains nonzero even index.
index_domain_coverage.justification: The addition uses analytic unit identities at O, integral group identities killing two-torsion and an anchor-first exclusion of exceptional H. Completeness retains old-subgroup witnesses.

transition_maps.required: Exact maps, degrees and nonzero divisors in each reduction, plus an adequate arithmetic proof where no old-witness bijection is claimed.
transition_maps.constructed: Shared reciprocals, norm charts, scaled biquadratic charts, normalized poles, rescaled anchor and extra ordinary multiplication gate.
transition_maps.justification: All maps and exceptional branches appear in the addition; consumer checks bind their outputs to the same root, logarithm and scalar values. General H and preparation-zero completeness are separately justified.

limiting_object_identity.required: The published coefficient table must be the sum of squares of the exact reviewed arithmetic system.
limiting_object_identity.constructed: Frozen394 and its compact input-first table; uniquely constrained 16 constant-chain coordinates and one product gate in the ordinary companion.
limiting_object_identity.justification: Complete coefficient reconstruction and coordinate-map checks establish the finite identity; no new analytic limit is introduced. Existing analytic inputs are not certified by this finite computation.

coefficient_conventions.required: Correct basis, normalized valuations, fixed-parameter interpretation, total counts and coefficient bounds.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: C=3^(2^25); 394 total variables and 6338 terms, 411 total and 6388 terms; content one, degree four.
coefficient_conventions.justification: The symbolic maximum is 16C^2 at W^2*tau^2, with no collisions. The ordinary maximum is 3247 bits and its text is 214957 bytes. Exact physical x-coordinate scalings are included in the source comparisons.

local_conditions.required: Preserve formal-depth transfer and local squareclasses and ensure the finite/real conditions hold simultaneously.
local_conditions.constructed: Order-ten input tests, order-forty remaining tests, depth24 scalar transfer, beta=51(2X+1)^2+2504 and c=r+4896.
local_conditions.justification: Correction-unit assertions are restricted to consumed contact primes. Preparation includes the whole support of cr and primes2,3,17; real-open-set and CRT choices use one compatible order and preserve the final b<17 bound.

exceptional_cases.required: No forbidden division, circular nonvanishing argument, free identity branch or wrong real-component assumption.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Zero comparison numerators; general H and H-P; scalar R near O or T0; anchor g1=0; private pole zero branches.
exceptional_cases.justification: Exceptional H are excluded using pre-ratio root heights and the restored anchor. Modular certificates replace global positivity of rational-log numerators. The even-index coefficient lemma precedes inverse restoration. Both scalar local branches and pole zero branches are retained.

downstream_consumption.required: Reduced precision and altered domains must still yield integer input soundness, all-integer completeness and the reported final polynomial.
downstream_consumption.constructed: Unchanged exponent19 heights and anchor, scalar24 margin, revised local ratios, oddness plus squarefree51 input bridge.
downstream_consumption.justification: The retained Version 13 section supplies the inequalities and simultaneous construction, with its exact historical coefficient artifacts and reviews. The consumer in Version 14 is the unchanged theorem labeled thm:v13-quartic, which explicitly states the P394/P411 counts and bounds. The new abstract concerns P299/P314 and is governed separately by QUARTIC-299-COMPOSITION.
